@xray: Ok, first of all you need to define your ball. in your projects PBS folder go to items.txt and open it up. You'll need to add a new item that represents your ball at the bottom of the text file. It will look something like this.

502,SHADOWBALL,SHADOW BALL,2,400,"An illegal BALL that can be used to catch a trainers POKéMON.",0,2502 is the item number and there should be a graphic called "item502.png" in the "graphics/items" folder, this will show up when you view the item in the menu. The graphic should be 48*48 pixels.
SHADOWBALL is the internal name of the item and is used to identify the item in any code.
SHADOW BALL is the name that will appear in the menu for the item
2 identifies the item as a BALL.
400 is the price of the item
The text inside the "quotation marks" will be the descritption text that shows up for the item.
0 tells the game that the item can be used only in battle
2 tells the game that when the item is used, it is a ball.
I'm going to assume that these values are the ones that you use.
Ok, now you need to go into the scripts (Press F11 in RMXP). Find the PokeBattle_Battle script. At the top there should be a section called 'def pbGetBallType(ball)'
You need to stick a comma at the end of the PREMIERBALL line then add a new line that reads:
:SHADOWBALLOk, now you need to find a section that reads
It should be around line 119. After that you'll need a new section to tell the game how likely the ball is to catch the pokémon.

rareness*=2In this example I've made the Ball have the same success rate as an Ultra Ball, you can look at the examples if you want the ball to have a different success rate but I'm not sure how to give it the same rate as a normal Poké Ball. You should then copy and paste this code at the end of line 213.
Ok, now for the part that tells the code that the Shadow Ball CAN catch trainers Pokémon. Line 78 of PokeBattle_Battle should contain this code:

if @opponent and itemname != "SHADOWBALL"That should do it! I haven't actually tested this but I think I've covered everything. If there are any problems then just let me know and I'll have a look at it. I hope that this helps!

then.text: Is this your first time on this floor? Well, welcome to the Tandor Network.
We provide services as \bOnline Battles, Virtual Training,\r GTS and Wonder Trading\c[0].
Would you like to know more about any of these services?

branches.text: Hello there!\nThis station allows you to access the online lobby. Once you're there, you can enter another trainer's ID number to add them as a friend. You will be able to see if your friend is online because the symbol by their name will be green.

Once they are online, you can ask them to trade or challenge them to battle. In player-vs-player battles, all Pokémon over level 50 will have their levels reduced to 50. -- NOTE -- PvP functionality is still in beta.
Have fun battling against your friends!
What do you want to learn about now?
Virtual Trainer is a system where you upload a virtual "clone" of yourself to an online
database of VTs. Anyone will be able to battle your Virtual Trainer.
And you're able to battle anyone that did the same too. There are \rthree\c[0] ways
to find virtual battles. The first is by searching through a \rVT Online ID\c[0].
Each VT has an unique ID, so that's the easiest way to battle a friend's VT.
The second way is searching by\r name\c[0], there may be duplicates, but it's also a good
way to find people to battle.
The third and most exciting one are the \rRanked Battles\c[0]! In those you are
matched with a random VT with about the same skill as you, and winning or losing
counts towards your\r Global Ranking\c[0]! Exciting things happen to those that are
high on the Rankings. Virtual Training is handled by my sister, she is on the desk
to the right! Good luck!
What do you want to learn about now?
GTS is short for Global Trading Station, in this system you leave a pokémon in our
care and we search a trainer that has what you are looking for. Or the other way around,
you search for trainers that have what you want and try to meet their criteria.
When both conditions are met, the trade occurs, simple as that!
Wonder Trade is a fun way of getting new pokémon! It's a blind exchange of one of
your pokémon with a random trainer that could be anywhere in Tandor. Fun, right?
What do you want to learn about now?
Looks like you already know all about it! See you then. If you wish to use any of the services, just talk to me.

branches.text: Saving progress \wt[10].\wt[10].\wt[10].\wtnp[10]
Ok! Come with me.
Thanks for using Tandor Network, come back anytime!
What would you like to know about?
It's a really simple process. Just choose \rCreate Virtual Trainer\c[0] on the VTC menu,
then choose your pre-battle, in-battle and post-battle dialogues and a trainer type
that suits you more! There are dozens to choose from.
Are you ready or do you still want to learn about something else?
Beforehand, your friend must have uploaded a VT to the system.
with that done you have two options. Searching for him by his \rID\c[0] or \r name\c[0].
Friendly Battle doesn't count towards win percentage, total battles or ranking.
Are you ready or do you still want to learn about something else?
\rRanked Battles\c[0] are battles against random VTs balanced by a \rTier\c[0].
\rTiers\c[0] are determined by the average party level of each trainer.
You can check on which tier you are when you access the VTC menu, it will on the top
of the screen, close to your Online ID.
You can also check how your virtual trainer is doing, if he won any matches against
real trainers around the world. Just choose \rCheck Virtual Trainer\c[0] in the VTC menu.
Are you ready or do you still want to learn about something else?
Your VT will be in the \rGlobal Ranking\c[0] once he battles 10 other trainers.
After that you will be bale to see your position on your VT profile.
Your position is based on Win Percentage and the total number of battles.
If you decide to recreate your VT, you will lose every record of wins, matches etc.
Are you ready or do you still want to learn about something else?
See you next time!
